The [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3500]] '''''Nova's Heart''''' was the private [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] of [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]]. It was named after the [[Nova's Heart (album)|holo-album of the same name]].
